name: BZ Permaculture Farm Collective
description: BZ Permaculture Farm Collective is a CSA (community-supported agriculture) farm in 3661F Deep Lake Boundary Rd., WA. Members receive a season-long share of the farm's harvest, supporting local growing while getting fresh, seasonal produce. Hours and availability change with the season, so confirm before visiting.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
